name: Automated machine line
description: Reference Trust Requirements Profile for an automated production line of machines running in sequence. Illustrative draft values, not certified safety limits.

scope.intended_use: Trust requirements for an automated line of machines and conveyors controlled by software or AI.
scope.boundary: One production line from infeed to outfeed, including its guarding and stop circuits.
out_of_scope: How the system is scored against these signals
How a halt or other action is enforced

scored_signals.reason: Rising vibration is an early sign of bearing wear, imbalance or a loose tool.
Overheating bearings fail quickly and can seize the line.
Running above rated speed raises jam and injury risk.
Frequent jams lead to manual clearing, the most common cause of line injuries.
Falling yield signals drift in the process or the model controlling it.
Decisions made on failing sensors should not be trusted.

standing_bands.range: all signals within acceptable operating range and no hard rule met
one or more signals in the warning range
a signal in the critical range or a hard rule met

required_standing.source_requirement: For audit or insurance use, the evaluation source should be independent.

notes: Threshold values are illustrative draft values, not certified safety limits.
This profile is a reference template. Real deployments should set values to their equipment and applicable safety practice.
